preparation_note: Direct inspection of the exact HNDM primary page fixes an explicit pedagogical prescription in Enrique C. Rebsamen's La Pedagogia Moderna. The bounded unit directs the educator to develop the learner's physical, intellectual, ethical and aesthetic faculties harmoniously and frames guidance by criterion and conscience. The next paragraph on physiological and psychological laws is excluded. No source text or image is committed.

The redaction endorses the requested statistical information for the Congreso de Instruccion and announces the forthcoming Reglamento under study by the Secretario de Justicia e Instruccion Publica. The official circular and Rebsamen article are excluded.
